title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - HARRIS-DAWSON, ET AL.) relative to funding for services in connection of the passing of Civil Rights Leader Dolores Huerta, including…
text:
[Council File 26-1551]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - HARRIS-DAWSON, ET AL.) relative to funding for services in connection of the passing of Civil Rights Leader Dolores Huerta, including the illumination of City Hall from Wednesday, October 28, 2026 to Thursday, October 29, 2026.
Recommendation(s) for Council action: SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $2,924 from the Council’s portion of the Heritage Month Celebrations & Special Events line item in the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56 to the General Services Fund No. 100/40, Account No. 1100 (Hiring Hall), for services in connection of the passing of Civil Rights Leader Dolores Huerta, including the illumination of City Hall from Wednesday, October 28, 2026 to Thursday, October 29, 2026.
